purpose: Fresh audit-only prospective validation of the M10A deterministic GOLD M5/H1/H4 payoff references without modifying, resetting, backfilling, or reusing the starts of M9V or M9Y.

upstream.eligibility: proxy_primary_time must be strictly greater than the independently frozen M10B prospective start. A first-turn after M10B start that belongs to a pre-M10B PRIMARY is forbidden.

M5.atr: Wilder ATR14 from latest fully closed M5 at first-turn decision
M5.immediate: If exact first-turn M1 open bid >= level, enter at that exact M1 open ask.
M5.delayed: Otherwise wait at most 6 fully closed M1 bars. After first closed M1 close >= level, enter exact next M1 open ask, strictly before native M5 EXIT.
M5.timeout: Skip if no causal reclaim before timeout/native EXIT.

H1.atr: Wilder ATR14 from latest fully closed H1 at first-turn decision
H1.confirmation: Use latest fully closed M5 at first-turn. If its close >= level, enter at exact first-turn M1 open ask. Otherwise wait for the first fully closed M5 close >= level within 30 minutes, then enter at the exact M1 open at that M5 close time, strictly before native H1 EXIT.
H1.timeout: Skip if no causal M5 reclaim confirmation within 30 minutes or native EXIT occurs first.

H4.level: original PRIMARY bid/open; no ATR offset
H4.confirmation: Use latest fully closed M15 at first-turn. If its close >= PRIMARY level, enter at exact first-turn M1 open ask. Otherwise wait for the first fully closed M15 close >= PRIMARY level within 60 minutes, then enter at the exact M1 open at that M15 close time, strictly before native H4 EXIT.
H4.timeout: Skip if no causal M15 reclaim confirmation within 60 minutes or native EXIT occurs first.

M5_RUNNER75.native_exit_event: Native M5 proxy EXIT is a profit-management event.
M5_RUNNER75.runner_eligibility: At native EXIT decision, latest fully closed M15 MACD(6,13) line is strictly greater than previous fully closed M15 MACD line.
M5_RUNNER75.runner_exit: First causal M5 RCI9 turn-down decision at or after native EXIT. If native EXIT decision itself is already such a turn-down, runner exits immediately.

H1_RUNNER50.native_exit_event: Native H1 proxy EXIT is a profit-management event.
H1_RUNNER50.runner_eligibility: At native EXIT decision, BOTH latest fully closed H4 MACD(6,13) and latest fully closed D1 MACD(6,13) lines are strictly greater than their respective previous fully closed values.
H1_RUNNER50.runner_exit: First causal H1 RCI9 turn-down decision at or after native EXIT. If native EXIT decision itself is already such a turn-down, runner exits immediately.

one_position_accounting.while_active: Do not open another trade in the same arm. Record later eligible entries as overlap/confirmation metadata.
one_position_accounting.runner_arm_active_until: runner exit when runner eligible; otherwise native exit

fresh_start_bootstrap.start_freeze_rule: Initialize only while all required live CSVs are current and stable. Freeze immutable row-prefix fingerprints and a new start before accepting any M10B candidate. Start must be strictly after existing M9V and M9Y starts.

reporting.cost_note: Live spread is embedded at actual entry via M1 ask. Commission and swap remain NOT MODELED.

review_gates.note: Checkpoint means manual review only. H4 remains premium/reference because frequency is very low.
